open_points.subject: MCP surface for releasing failed runs
open_points.text: “The kernel exposes one fixed set of typed operations over `mcp`: inspect, author, try, run, resume, read traces, and the owner's approve, accept, activate, grant, revoke, resolve and cancel.” contradicts “release a failed run | owner, agent” and `capability:runs.release_run`.
open_points.question: How is the required release action exposed when `release` is absent from the stated fixed MCP operation set?
options: Add a distinct release operation to the fixed surface
Define one listed operation as a tagged umbrella that includes release
Remove release as a callable action
open_points.default_guess: Expose release as a distinct operation because the primary-action table, A16 and State 4 all require callers to invoke it.

open_points.subject: Who may request flow activation
open_points.text: “the owner's approve, accept, activate, grant, revoke, resolve and cancel” contradicts “activate a flow | agent or owner asks” and “the owner or any agent asks to activate”.
open_points.question: May an agent request activation of a proven read-only flow, or is every activation request owner-only?
options: An agent or the owner may request read-only activation; effectful activation is owner-only
open_points.default_guess: Allow an agent or the owner to request read-only activation, with the kernel recorded as activator; keep effectful activation owner-only.

open_points.subject: `bindings.check_installed_instances` startup validation
open_points.text: “for one it also selects an instance for, a manifest record that cannot be read or fails a check of the record itself (A08 rule 5) stops the start naming it”
open_points.question: Which exact A08 rule 5 checks must run at startup, and over which operations, when this step has no proposed binding, operation name or proposal ports with which to perform the operation-specific and port-specific checks?
options: Check only the service-record envelope and selected-instance/header facts needed by the startup collision check
Validate every capability entry using all checks that do not require proposal ports
Run no capability validation at startup and defer operation checks to proposal, acceptance and send
open_points.default_guess: Check only the service-record envelope plus the selected-instance and required-header facts needed for the credential-header collision check, deferring operation-specific checks.
